parsed.change_summary: No changes were made to the code as the reported finding (CWE-78: OS Command Injection) does not apply to the given code fragment. The function `load_ssh_private_key` does not execute any shell commands; it only reads the content of a file into memory and processes it using the Gcrypt library.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding (an attacker providing a filename that includes shell metacharacters or a path traversal sequence) does not apply to this code fragment. The function `fread` is used to read the file content, and there is no shell command execution involved. Therefore, the reported vulnerability is not present in the provided code.
